content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Explain the difference between String, StringBuilder, and StringBuffer."},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Understanding the differences between String, StringBuilder, and StringBuffer is crucial for efficient string manipulation in Java.
